issues.explanation: Login and register routes render missing views auth.login/auth.register instead of Livewire full-page components, so GET /login and /register cannot work and contract is violated.
Verification uses Auth::findUserById which does not exist on the Auth facade, so email verification throws instead of verifying.
Password::defaults with min 8, letters, mixed case and numbers is never configured and both Register and ResetPassword validate password as only required|confirmed.
Register rate limiter is never incremented and key omits str()->transliterate, so the 5-attempt IP throttle can never trigger.
Login redirects with redirect()->route(home) instead of an intended redirect to home, losing the stored intended URL.
Login and register validate email with required|email instead of strict validation.

verification.verify route omits throttle and verification controllers live under Auth while logout and password controllers are also under Auth against the contract; .env.example and phpunit.xml locale pins are absent from the diff.
Livewire components use rules() instead of the required #[Validate] attributes plus validate(), and Livewire Blade views use @extends/layout sections instead of a Livewire layout.
No Pest/PHPUnit tests ship with the change, including the required happy-path, validation, unauthorized-call and tamper tests.
Weak password rule plus non-functional register throttle and missing verify-link throttle leave credential and enumeration abuse paths open.
Unused imports and mis-indented verify block make review harder.
Unused facade and broker imports add dead code without behavior.

conventions.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:192-198 rules() without #[Validate]; resources/views/livewire/auth/login.blade.php:534 @extends inside Livewire view; routes/web.php:644-650 closures returning views

readability.evidence: app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerificationController.php:144-153 mis-indented nesting; unused imports e.g. AuthManager, PasswordBroker; Auth::findUserById wrong API

requirements.evidence: routes/web.php:644-650 view(auth.login) vs Livewire contract; app/Http/Controllers/Auth/VerificationController.php:139 Auth::findUserById wrong API; missing Password::defaults and intended redirect at app/Livewire/Auth/Login.php:214

scope.evidence: change.diff:1-685 all new routes, controllers, views and lang files serve auth; no unrelated refactors

security.evidence: app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:252-259 only required|confirmed; app/Livewire/Auth/Register.php:265-269 limiter never hit; routes/web.php:679-681 verify omits throttle

simplicity.evidence: Needed controllers and views only, but unused imports in ForgotPasswordController.php:12, LogoutController.php:46, ResetPasswordController.php:72-80

tests.evidence: change.diff:1-685 contains no tests/ directory changes and no Pest coverage

review.summary: Adds session auth scaffolding with correct translation keys and route() usage, but login/register routes miss Livewire components, verification calls a nonexistent Auth method, and Password::defaults plus strict email and locale pins are missing. With no tests and broken rate-limiting, the change needs substantial rework before merge.
